_meta.purpose: The checked-in roster scripts/check-portal-federation-health.mjs diffs the live registry against, so a product that silently drops out of /api/v1/app-registry/apps (the '13 of 18' symptom) fails loudly instead of producing a shorter-but-still-green table.
_meta.notASlugMigrationWorklist: This file is NOT authority to edit any product's registered `slug`. Per CLAUDE.md §'slug, display name, and the federated serve path are THREE INDEPENDENT questions', slug is free at registration and immutable after. If a live registry slug genuinely differs from an entry below, FIX THIS FILE to match the registry — never the other way around. This list exists only to notice disappearance, not to prescribe naming.
_meta.maintainedBy: owner (izzywdev) — add an entry when a new product joins the family, remove one when a product is formally retired, correct the slug if a `confidence` below turns out wrong.
_meta.countRationale: 19 entries. Re-reconciled against the live registry by census run 34261472714 (2026-09-08), which returned 16 apps: executive, finance, fuzehub, deploy, market, sales, contact, service, fuzekeys, fuzesocial, fuzeagent, clock, picker, fuzeservice, fuzesales, fuzequality. Every roster defect found so far has been the same shape -- an entry naming a slug no product has ever registered, which yields a MISSING row indistinguishable from a product that genuinely dropped out. Four have now been corrected: 'fuzesales' -> 'sales' and 'fuzeservice' -> 'service' (2026-09-07, each also listed as absent while its live twin went unlisted), 'merchandize' -> 'fuzemerchandize' (2026-09-07, the file's only 'inferred' entry), and 'fuzeplan' -> 'plan' (2026-09-08, the file's last 'documented' entry, sourced only from the RETIRED slug-deprefix runbook). The stranded 'fuzesales' and 'fuzeservice' rows are suspended by applications migration 013, so the portal shows one tile per product; the roster names the surviving slug in each pair. No entry now rests on 'documented' or 'inferred' confidence: every slug is read either from BUILTIN_MANIFESTS, from the product's own registration/manifest.json, or from the owner's 2026-08-19 ruling.

confidenceLevels.verified: slug read directly from the code that decides it -- either BUILTIN_MANIFESTS in this repo (backend/applications/src/app-registry/builtins.ts) for a built-in, or the product's own registration/manifest.json for a self-registering product, which production stores verbatim (backend/applications/src/app-registry/service.ts: slug: row.slug) and register.sh re-PUTs on every pod start. Cannot be stale without the owning repo changing its own registration.
confidenceLevels.owner-ruling: slug is one of the exact values the owner named on 2026-08-19 (quoted verbatim in CLAUDE.md §'slug, display name, and the federated serve path') as either a prefixed exception to keep (fuzex, fuzebi) or an already-correct unprefixed slug not to be migrated.
confidenceLevels.documented: slug taken from a specific named FuzeFront doc that is not itself flagged RETIRED/historical-snapshot for this purpose, but was not independently re-measured for this file.
confidenceLevels.inferred: no direct citation found; slug is a best guess by family naming convention. Treat a MISSING result for one of these as 'go verify the real slug', not as proof the product is down.

sources: CLAUDE.md §'slug, display name, and the federated serve path are THREE INDEPENDENT questions' (owner ruling, 2026-08-19, quoted verbatim)

docs/runbooks/app-slug-deprefix-migration.md — RETIRED; no entry in this file relies on it any more (the last one, 'fuzeplan', was corrected to 'plan' on 2026-09-08 against FuzePlan's own manifest). Do not reintroduce it as a source.

izzywdev/FuzeSales, izzywdev/FuzeService, izzywdev/FuzeMerchandize and izzywdev/FuzePlan registration/manifest.json -- each product's own declared slug, which production stores verbatim (backend/applications/src/app-registry/service.ts: slug: row.slug) and register.sh re-PUTs on every pod start
_meta.genuinelyAbsentAtLastReview: Census 34261472714 (2026-09-08) MISSING set, after these corrections: call, fuzebi, plan, fuzex, fuzemerchandize. All five are absent because nothing has ever written their registry row -- not because a row was removed. Each cause is owned by the product's own repo (or FuzeInfra), never by editing this file: call -- FuzeInfra's one-time `argocd-register` has never run for izzywdev/FuzeCall, so there is no fuzecall namespace and no Ingress at all (/apps/call answers 404); fuzebi -- deployed and its remote SERVES (probe 34157206072: /apps/fuzebi/remoteEntry.js is 200 with all chunks), but the registration init container rides the BACKEND Deployment, whose `fuzefront-registration` Secret does not exist in the fuzebi namespace, so it never runs (izzywdev/FuzeBI helm/fuzebi/templates/_sealed-fuzefront-registration.RESERVED.txt); fuzex and fuzemerchandize -- Ingress exists but nothing healthy backs it (503), so their fail-closed init containers never complete; plan -- deployed and running, but its chart registers via a PostSync Job against the LEGACY unauthenticated /api/apps/register that swallows failures with process.exit(0) (see that entry's `source`). A 503/404 here is evidence about SERVING, not about the slug: never edit a slug to chase one.

apps.name: Plan
apps.source: izzywdev/FuzePlan registration/manifest.json: "slug": "plan", "name": "Plan". CORRECTED from 'fuzeplan', which came only from the RETIRED docs/runbooks/app-slug-deprefix-migration.md snapshot (the file's own 'documented' confidence level warned it had not been re-measured). No product has ever registered 'fuzeplan': census run 34261472714 (2026-09-08) returns neither 'plan' nor 'fuzeplan', so the old entry produced a MISSING row for a slug that does not exist -- the same false signal already corrected for 'merchandize', 'fuzesales' and 'fuzeservice'. FuzePlan is genuinely unregistered under EITHER name, for a cause its own repo owns: deploy/helm/fuzeplan/templates/register-hook.yaml is a PostSync Job that POSTs an unauthenticated, slug-less payload to the LEGACY POST /api/apps/register -- which has required authentication since appsec #100 (backend/src/routes/apps.ts:719) and whose insert sets neither `slug` nor `manifest`, both of which backend/applications/src/app-registry/service.ts:212 requires (.whereNotNull('slug').whereNotNull('manifest')). The Job swallows every failure with process.exit(0), so it reports Succeeded while never writing a registry row. The fail-closed init container that would consume this manifest is not wired into that chart.
